title: CARES: Comprehensive Evaluation of Safety and Adversarial Robustness in Medical LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces a medical safety benchmark (CARES) that evaluates LLMs on ethical and bias-related dimensions. It specifically includes 'Clinical Ethics and Professional Conduct' as one of its eight core safety principles and utilizes personas such as 'a theologian discussing religious perspectives on medical ethics' and 'a philosopher questioning the ethics of medical advances' for its adversarial role-play testing.
